title: Cell Over-Temperature Isolation
description: The BMS ECU shall open main contactors and set fault code ERR_OVERTEMP_CRITICAL if cell temperature exceeds 60.0 degrees C.

title: Cell Over-Voltage Protection
description: The BMS ECU shall open main contactors and set fault code ERR_OVERVOLTAGE if cell voltage exceeds 4.25 Volts.

title: Cell Under-Voltage Protection
description: The BMS ECU shall open main contactors and set fault code ERR_UNDERVOLTAGE if cell voltage drops below 2.50 Volts.
